# Ada

> Ada is a free, open-source "Dynamic Island" for Windows 10 and 11: a small black notch at the top of the screen
> that shows what you need without opening another window. Native Rust (Direct2D + DirectComposition), ~700 KB,
> uses no CPU when idle (0 FPS). Apache-2.0.

## What it does
- Now playing from any app (Windows media controls) with synced lyrics (LRCLIB)
- Pomodoro focus timer
- Weather for your location (MET Norway, location by IP, no setup)
- CPU and RAM monitor
- File and link shelf: drag files in and out
- Todo list and a local calendar
- Windows notification previews ("peeks")
- An idle mascot that writes "Merhaba" (Turkish for hello) and waves
- Every page can be turned off in Settings; a minimal mode is available

## Install
- Download the installer (Ada-Setup-x.y.z.exe) or the portable ada.exe: https://github.com/Yemresalcan/ada-notch/releases/latest
- No admin rights needed. Windows may show a SmartScreen reputation warning because the app is new and not code-signed yet;
  verify the download with SHA256SUMS.txt from the same release.

## Privacy
Everything stays local in %APPDATA%\Ada, no telemetry. Only weather and lyrics are fetched from the network when enabled.
